understood_as: Evaluate the frozen source actor, frozen p=1-adapted actor, and unchanged carried_grain>0 gate on the predefined PACK TEST natural-start panel, without learning or gate changes.
research_question: Does carry-gated execution improve p=0.05 expected discounted return over the source actor on start states unused by policy learning and gate design?

conditions.source: Use the frozen normal-training actor at every step.
conditions.adapted: Use the frozen p=1 overwrite-adapted actor at every step.
conditions.carry_gated: Use the adapted actor when carried_grain > 0 and the source actor otherwise.

heldout_panel.full_state_hash_convention: SHA-256 each ordered state over PyTree leaves using UTF-8 leaf_index|NumPy dtype.str|shape| followed by C-order bytes; panel hash is SHA-256 of concatenated per-state ASCII hex digests.

evaluation.primary_metric: carry_gated minus source p=0.05 expected discounted return

analysis.paired_by: seed and held-out TEST state index

decision_rule.multi_seed_improvement: A positive mean with improvements across multiple seeds supports broader state-panel applicability, not new-seed generalization.
decision_rule.seed35_concentration: If improvement is again concentrated in seed 35, describe the gate as repairing one adapted policy's normal-task damage.
decision_rule.no_improvement: The validation-panel benefit did not transfer to this held-out TEST panel.

non_claims: TEST changes map geometry as well as initial physical state; this is not an i.i.d. resample of the validation states.
The same five learner seeds and checkpoints are reused, so this does not test generalization to new learned policies.
The gate is evaluator supplied and was not learned.
The prior four seed-35 failures remain a validation-panel case analysis and are not part of this primary comparison.
Exact p=0.05 values are finite-panel expectations derived from deterministic fixed paths.

stop_rule: Evaluate exactly three frozen execution conditions on 32 TEST natural starts for five seeds and two endpoint kernels; do not add learning, seeds, gates, maps, or thresholds.
